summary: Half in near the October low: the trend is still down, but much of the fall has already happened.
reasons: Nifty is below its 200-day average and the 50-day average is below the 200-day, so the trend is down.
Nifty is about 14% below its January high and close to its 8 Oct low of 22,232.
A half position gets part of any rebound without betting everything.
